newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to postpone new modem shipments.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to postpone new modem shipments.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Friday it will postpone further shipments of its recently announced ModemSURFR and VoiceSURFR 56 K modems as it works with Rockwell International Corp to improve the performance of the device's chipset.

The company said there is an issue that affects the modem's performance in a small number of network configurations. Motorola said the problem is likely to affect fewer than 3,000 customers since the modems shipped last week.
Motorola said it will replace modems at no cost for customers who have already purchased a ModemSURFR 56 K modem and experienced performance problems.
Motorola makes electronic systems and semiconductors.
Its shares were unchanged Friday at 55-3/4.
